# Offline Urth globe geography

`natural-earth-land-110m.geojson` is the Natural Earth 1:110m land-polygon
theme, vendored from commit
`ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19` of the
[`nvkelso/natural-earth-vector`](https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector)
repository.

Natural Earth publishes all of its raster and vector map data in the public
domain. The game bundles this small-scale vector copy so the Desk Globe remains
fully functional offline; the shipped game never contacts a map service.

Source file:
`geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson`

Project and terms:

- https://www.naturalearthdata.com/
- https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
